scope: G0 follow-up hypothesis after off-center crop failures; centered crop with matched size to diagnose principal-point/context confounding; single development asset, not held-out evidence
roi_provenance: Deterministic image-centered 1152x900 RGB rectangle, preserving original image center (960,540). Chosen after examining off-center crop failures to probe the principal-point hypothesis; not selected with GT projection or optimized by GT error. Shared across thinner/origin variants. Top crop truncates a small portion of rods; partial field of view, no whole-object recovery claim. Image content and context also change, so improvement alone cannot isolate principal point as the cause.

line_control.selection: RGB symmetric ridge contrast in manually corresponding strips, all qualifying rows; no depth or GT-based inlier selection
line_control.fit: unweighted TLS; single straight segment is a deliberately simple baseline, real gap not manually supplied
line_control.diagnostics_only: Native curve outputs with manual cross-view identity; not common CurveReadout or final recovery benchmark
